dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Two distinct white bands are visible; the median covert bar is thick and shows high grayscale contrast, while the greater covert bar is narrower and longer.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Very sharp, prominent pale edges are visible along the outer margins of the folded primary and secondary flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A distinct, horizontal semi-circular white-to-pale-yellow patch is visible on the posterior neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A sharp, high-contrast linear boundary separates the dark crown from the pale nape patch, which then clearly demarcates the start of the grayish mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent dark longitudinal streaking is visible across the grayish-blue mantle and scapular region.
